title: Consulting by year (Konsultkollen)
description: Cinode's annual Konsultkollen reports 2021 to 2026, covering 200 to 370 Swedish consultancies with at least 15 staff. Growth of the typical firm on the year before; Cinode calls it the median in its 2022 to 2024 reports and growth on average in later ones.

rows.note: Half the firms shrank; the Volvo companies cut most of their hired consultants, hitting Gothenburg hardest
A third of firms cut staff
IT consultancies -0.1% revenue, -1.8% staff; technology consultancies +3.5% revenue
